principles: Do not optimize or automate provider execution until the evidence boundary is explicit.
Only fix the real launch correctness issue: authorization metadata must be auditable and bounded.
Keep host-neutral separation between provider model snapshots and host adapter labels.
Preserve sequencing: cell 03 before any budget lock, and cell 06 only after a real cell-03-derived budget lock.
Status output must make what is done, in progress, blocked, and not started visible to the user.
drivers: Provider execution is spend-sensitive and must not be enabled by ambiguous metadata.
B-11be is scoped to USD 0.00 provider budget and local metadata/checker/docs only.
Existing M2 checker intentionally rejects accidental providerExecutionAuthorized=true and must keep rejecting unsafe states.

options.name: flip-existing-launch-boolean
cons: Would bypass the existing safety guard
Could imply provider cells may run without complete metadata

options.name: metadata-only-authorized-boundary
pros: Records user approval and budget boundary without provider spend
Lets checker distinguish safe metadata from accidental execution enablement
Keeps cell 03 as future separately budgeted step and cell 06 blocked
cons: Does not run provider cells in this story
Requires a later story for actual cell 03 execution

options.name: run-cell-03-now
pros: Would begin collecting real data sooner
cons: Needs nonzero budget cap and exact provider snapshots not yet pinned for execution
Risks wasting provider credit before metadata guard is proven

rationale: Choose metadata-only authorized boundary because it resolves the real correctness issue found by INIT review while preserving the existing no-provider-spend guard and the documented cell sequencing.

preMortem.trigger: Required metadata is missing or host labels are accepted as snapshots
preMortem.consequence: Future agents could treat invalid provider rows as formal evidence
preMortem.mitigation: Add negative controls for missing fields, host-label snapshots, provider fallback, and cell 06 enablement.

preMortem.trigger: A command or doc path enables provider execution inside B-11be
preMortem.consequence: Budget is spent and result rows appear outside the approved scope
preMortem.mitigation: Keep provider budget cap USD 0.00, exclude provider CLI commands, and assert no records/outcome paths exist.

preMortem.trigger: Status docs say authorization metadata implies Phase 1 data or model-agnostic proof
preMortem.mitigation: Update docs to say no provider cells ran, no H-M1/H-M3 proof exists, and product gate impact is none.

preMortem.trigger: Authorization metadata is interpreted as a real cell-03-derived budget lock
preMortem.mitigation: Checker must keep cell 06 blocked until a real cell-03-derived budget lock artifact from later execution exists.
